name: moonbit_diff
description: MoonBit Myers/linear diff fixture exercising line splitting, bipolar arrays, shortest-edit-script construction, and pretty-printing.

exports.name: bipolar_array_matches
exports.description: Harness export that validates the bipolar array helper used by the diff frontier logic.

exports.name: identical_lines_match
exports.description: Harness export that diffs identical multi-line text and compares the pretty-printed equal-line output.

exports.name: insert_delete_summary_matches
exports.description: Harness export that diffs text with one deletion and one insertion, then summarizes edit counts.

exports.name: myers_example_matches
exports.description: Harness export that runs the classic Myers ABCABBA to CBABAC example and compares the rendered edit script.

tests.description: exercise MoonBit diff helpers and representative edit-script paths
tests.notes: The diff implementation returns MoonBit GC-managed arrays and strings. The harness uses fixed readable text inputs, calls the real linear_diff and pprint_diff functions, and reduces the checks to i32 pass/fail results for the corpus runner.

steps.description: validate bipolar array positive and negative indexing
steps.notes: Writes values at positive indices 0 and 1 and negative indices -1 and -2, then reads them back through the translated storage positions used by the diff frontier.
Uses 'same / same / same' on both sides and checks the pretty printer emits only equal-line rows.

steps.description: count a simple insertion and deletion
steps.notes: Diffs 'alpha beta gamma delta' against 'alpha gamma epsilon delta' and expects one insert, one delete, and three equal lines.

steps.description: run the classic Myers shortest-edit-script example
steps.notes: Diffs ABCABBA against CBABAC and checks the complete pretty-printed script, exercising a less trivial path through the linear diff algorithm.

source.description: Apache-2.0 MoonBit documentation diff implementation compiled with a local export harness for corpus tests.

notes: The committed Wasm was built from the official MoonBit docs diff example plus a small local export harness. The tests intentionally use readable source strings so it is clear which edit paths are being exercised.
